caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with a rectangular shape, rendered in shades of brown to represent the wood grain and texture. The chest has a flat lid with slightly beveled edges and stands on four bracket legs. Along the front, there is a decorative, yellow-colored keyhole plate in the center. Below the keyhole plate, a yellow-outlined, greenish plaque is visible with the inscription "HA HERBSTIN 1786" in white letters, flanked by the letters "HA" on either side. The chest's lower section includes a base with a horizontal molding and two small drawer-like designs, each with a central knob. The background is plain beige, with the chest centered within a faint rectangular border. The artist's signature is located in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Chest
